domestic_packages.title: Haridwar Corbett Nainital Tour Package
highlights: Sacred Ganga River at Har Ki Pauri in Haridwar
Evening Ganga Aarti at Harki Pauri
Jim Corbett National Park — wildlife safaris (morning & evening)
Naini Peak and Naini Lake boat ride
Hanumangarhi Temple, Bhimtal Lake, Naukuchai Tal, Sat Tal Lake
Mall Road stroll and shopping in Nainital
River rafting and trekking opportunities at Corbett

itinerary.title: Arrival in Delhi → Haridwar
itinerary.description: Upon arrival in Delhi, depart for Haridwar. Check into hotel and relax. Visit temples including Mansa Devi and Chamunda Devi. In the evening, witness the Ganga Aarti at Har Ki Pauri. Overnight stay in Haridwar.

itinerary.title: Haridwar → Jim Corbett (200 km)
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from hotel and depart for Jim Corbett. If time permits, experience river rafting and trekking activities. Overnight stay in Corbett.

itinerary.title: Jim Corbett National Park Safaris
itinerary.description: Early morning jungle safari with experienced naturalist. Evening safari as well. Overnight in Corbett.

itinerary.title: Corbett → Nainital (70 km)
itinerary.description: After breakfast, depart for Nainital. Check into hotel. Explore the area. Evening stroll along Mall Road with shopping. Overnight in Nainital.

itinerary.title: Nainital Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Visit Naini Peak, boat ride on Naini Lake, Hanumangarhi Temple, Bhimtal Lake, Naukuchai Tal, and Sat Tal Lake. Evening leisure or Mall Road. Overnight in Nainital.

itinerary.title: Nainital → Delhi (Departure)
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out and drive back to Delhi. Transfer to airport or railway station for onward journey.

inclusions: Accommodation on double sharing basis in standard category rooms
Breakfast and dinner at all hotels
All transfers and sightseeing by private air-conditioned car
Fuel, toll taxes, road taxes, driver's allowance included
All applicable hotel taxes and service taxes
exclusions: Meals other than those specified in itinerary
Hotel upgrades due to force majeure
Airfare, train fare, visa fees, medical insurance
Entrance fees to monuments and camera fees
Personal expenses (porterage, laundry, telephone, shopping, alcohol, mineral water)

domestic_packages.title: Chardham Yatra Tour Package
highlights: Yamunotri — first of the four sacred shrines
Gangotri — source of the holy River Ganga
Kedarnath — ancient Shiva temple in the Himalayas
Badrinath — sacred Vishnu shrine
Spectacular Himalayan vistas throughout
domestic_packages.description: Experience a profoundly spiritual journey covering the four holy shrines of Uttarakhand — Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath, and Badrinath. Our Chardham Yatra packages provide a perfect blend of spirituality, devotion, and breathtaking mountain scenery.

domestic_packages.title: Mussoorie Nainital Hill Station Tour
highlights: Kempty Waterfall — soothing retreat amidst nature
Laltibba — panoramic views of surrounding mountains
Naini Lake boat ride
Mall Road shopping
Misty hills and scenic lakes
domestic_packages.description: Nainital and Mussoorie travel deals provide the enchanting beauty of misty hills and scenic lakes with cool mountain air. Perfect for couples, families, and solo travelers seeking a relaxing getaway.

domestic_packages.title: Jim Corbett Wildlife Safari Tour
highlights: Tiger spotting in dense forests
Exotic wildlife photography opportunities
Experienced naturalist-guided safaris
Morning and evening safari sessions
domestic_packages.description: Experience memorable moments in the wild at Jim Corbett National Park — North India's most famous wildlife destination. Spot tigers, leopards, elephants, and diverse exotic wildlife in their natural habitat.

domestic_packages.title: Mukteshwar & Kumaon Hills Tour
highlights: Mukteshwar Mahadev Temple
Mukteshwar Dham
Chauli Ki Jali — sacred scenic spot
Panoramic Himalayan views
Mystical spiritual ambiance
domestic_packages.description: Discover the spiritual charm of Mukteshwar with visits to the Mukteshwar Mahadev Temple and immerse in the divine atmosphere of the Kumaon hills.

domestic_packages.title: Golden Triangle Tour — Delhi Agra Jaipur
highlights: Delhi: India Gate, Qutub Minar, Lotus Temple, Jama Masjid, President's House, Chandni Chowk, Janpath
Agra: Taj Mahal, Red Fort, Sikandra, Itmad-ud-daula, Fatehpur Sikri
Jaipur: Hawa Mahal and other landmarks
domestic_packages.description: India's most iconic travel circuit. Explore the grandeur of the Mughal Empire and the splendor of Rajasthan royalty in one seamlessly planned tour.

domestic_packages.title: Haridwar Rishikesh Spiritual Tour
highlights: Ganga Aarti at Har Ki Pauri
River rafting in Rishikesh
Temple visits
Yoga and meditation (optional)
domestic_packages.description: Explore the holy towns of Haridwar and Rishikesh — where peaceful Ganga Aarti and thrilling river rafting await. Perfect for spiritual seekers and adventure lovers alike.
